clue.text: Small creature, not unlike an antelope
Game is originally much different on International Workers' Day
Native American stirred Coke here
Look northward in Vermont unit
Think again about scone, chewed and swallowed by passenger
In Montreal, seven unprotected lice infested with bacteria
Insect putting its head underneath a piece of paper
Draws carts bit by bit, with some repetition
Kiss faceless bum
Expend too much energy flipping dinosaur before edges of volcano
Marshall Mathers' college
Chooses to run back through memoir of St. Polycarp
In Asia, Frank translated a Germanic language
Express drama, perhaps overlooking some of the hospital dead
104 independent contractors at the forefront of government
Pair of Visigoths tallying nuts in a watchful manner
Celebrity to gobble eyeball
Cleans fake post office rings
In Guadalajara, two times the appropriate amounts
Far from downtown, burn a bus after an accident
War god takes one sign
Stigma surrounds liberal dictator
Baldwin turned to suppress insubordinate parts of the brain
Grant's alternating current wire
Braid bread around the east side of Galesburg, Illinois
Whip up an activity, of course
Persistent fashion that's entertaining? Right on
Scattered arcs: nine can be found in the completed diagram
Engine component is malfunctioning? Fire it (LOL)
Coming in late, Hedda is more adept
